clerk.name: Clerk
clerk.description: Writes up loans, bond purchases and venture shares: one deal a quarter.

correspondent.name: Correspondent
correspondent.description: Writes to merchants and agents abroad: two reports on borrowers a quarter, and each one after the first makes reports cheaper.

analyst.name: Analyst
analyst.description: Reads a borrower's books and writes an opinion: two a quarter, right more often with skill.

teller.name: Teller
teller.description: Serves depositors at the counter: in calm times deposits grow faster.

partner.name: Partner
partner.description: A junior partner shares the head's work: more of the head's time, cheaper courting and marriages, warmer houses.

strongroom.name: Strongroom
strongroom.description: Iron doors and a vault: depositors trust it, bring more money in calm years, and ask for less of it in a panic.

archive.name: Archive
archive.description: Shelves of old ledgers: payment records go back further.

courier_stable.name: Courier stable
courier_stable.description: Riders on the post roads: warnings of a panic reach the house at once, not a quarter late, and prices from Vienna and Paris arrive first, so bonds are bought below the market.

reception_rooms.name: Reception rooms
reception_rooms.description: Rooms fit to receive the bourse: courting wins more favour, houses agree to marriages more readily, and the house's name rises a little every year.

warehouse.name: Warehouse
warehouse.description: A warehouse on the Main: space to store goods.

traits.name: Careful
traits.description: Sees trouble everywhere, and sometimes where there is none.

traits.name: Sanguine
traits.description: Expects the best, and is sometimes surprised.

liquidity.alarm: Our cash would not meet one quarter of a panic's withdrawals. I would keep more of it in the strongbox and lend a little less.
liquidity.calm: The books are in order. Our cash would meet a quarter of panic withdrawals, should one come.

market.alarm: Our friends in Hamburg and London write that paper is refused and coin hoarded. I fear a panic within the year.
market.calm: The letters from abroad are quiet. I see no panic coming this year.

family.alarm: {heir} is not yet ready to lead the house. Another year of schooling would serve us all.
family.calm: {heir} is ready to lead the house, should it come to that.
family.none: The house has no heir. We must think of marriages and children.
